stories.title: 0004_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text: Mbui, Ngiti na Ng'ombe mai anyanyae anene. Muthenyia umwe maendie kyalo na ngali.

stories.title: 0004_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text: Mavika kwisho wa kyaloi, Ndeleva amea maive tikiti. Ng'ombe aiva tikiti wake.

stories.title: 0004_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text: Ngiti aiva tikiti umwingaingi, nundu ndaii na mbesa ila syailite.

stories.title: 0004_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text: Ndeleva akwenda utungia Ngiti mbesa sya uluui, Mbui aumela asembete ataivite kindu!

stories.title: 0004_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text: Ndeleva athata muno. Atwaa ngali atanatungia Ngiti mbesa sya yuulu.

stories.title: 0004_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text: Ni kwio kitumi ona umunze Ngiti usembea ngali akunikile nzini aimaza Ndeleva ula utamutungia mbesa syake sya yuulu.

stories.title: 0004_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text: Mbui nake asembaa aitoloka muumo wa ngali. Ethia aikia ndakakwatwe nundu wa ulea iva tikiti wake.

stories.title: 0004_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text: Na Ng'ombe ndatelemaa ngali yukite. Ng'ombe osaa ivinda yake kukilanilia nzia nundu niwaivie tikiti wake wonze!

stories.title: 0005_anansi-na-nguu.md
stories.text:
Muthenya umwe, mbuavui Anansi
niwosie ikwa kuma muundani wake.
Mai maseo kuvituka kwou
amaumbika mwakini mavye. Na
ekala nthi amaye.

stories.title: 0005_anansi-na-nguu.md
stories.text:
Kavinda ukwenda kuuma yambee,
ew’a mwango wake wakunangwa. “
Ai ekai”, avindisya Anansi. “ Nuu
usu” ateo avingua muango.
Vai nguu ula wonekaa emunou
muno. Nguu asya, “Anansi eka
nilike. Nitembeete kuma vaasa
umunthi na ni munou muno na nina
nzaa”. Kwou Anansi ee eka ata ateo
kumweka alike?

stories.title: 0005_anansi-na-nguu.md
stories.text:
Ateo Anansi ai mutoonu muno
kwithiwa atatonya kwisiania na
mundu ikwa syake onethia ni
mueni. Kwou aseuvya muvango.
Saa ila nguu wekalile nthi na ambiia
kwenda kuya ikwa syai mesani
Anansi atulya wasya na asya. “
Nguu moko maku mena kiko muno!
Ndwamba kuya namo mena kiko.
Thi umanthambye”.
Kwaw’o moko ma nguu mai na kiko
nundu nimo vatumiaa kutembea
nthiani yonthe. Kavola, nguu athi
usini kuthambya moko na asyoka
yingi vala vai liu.

stories.title: 0005_anansi-na-nguu.md
stories.text:
Na kavinda kau Anansi ambiia
kumelya ikwa kumelya. Ivinda ila
nguu wasyokaa niwonie kana vayai
ikwa. Nguu alilya Anansi na amwia “
Nimuvea muno nundu wa
kumbaalika liuni wa wiwoo. Kavinda
konthe wi wakuvi na nyumba yakwa
thi ukoka ngutungie muvea.” Na
nguu akunga kavola aendete
kwake.

stories.title: 0005_anansi-na-nguu.md
stories.text:
O matuku maendee Anansi avindiya muno undu
weiwe ni nguu kana akamuie liu wa wiio wa mana.
Na muthenya umwe avitila nyumbani ya Nguu.
Anansi avikie nyumbani ya Nguu saa sya liu wa wioo
sua yendee na uthua iulu wa usi. Nguu otaa mwaki
wa ivia otondu wakothaa kwika.
Ila Nguu wonie Anansi aisye “ uvoo, wooka nikana
tuye liu wa wioo, vamwe”. Anansi asya,” I”i, uu ni
useo muno, nimuvea”. Aendee na kwiw’a nzaa
munango.

stories.title: 0005_anansi-na-nguu.md
stories.text:
Na Nguu ethika kiwuni usini
aseuvya mesa ya liu wa wiyoo vo.
Nake Anansi eteela e iviani kuu iulu
utee wa usi.
Mituki Nguu akenela na asya “oh
Anansi! Kila kindu ni kiseo yu uka
tuye liu wa wioo”. Na Nguu asyoka
nthi wa kiwu usini na ambia kuya
matu me kisunzuni ala mai liu wa
wioo.

stories.title: 0005_anansi-na-nguu.md
stories.text:
Anansi atata ulika kiwuni ateo
nundu ai mbuavui ndai alika kiwuni
ekaa o kulela. Atatie kila undu,
kutuila, kwithika ateo ndatetheka.
Ndai avikia liu usu.

stories.title: 0005_anansi-na-nguu.md
stories.text:
Mwisyo Anansi okiwa ni isuania.
Ekia mavia maingi mivukoni ya ikoti
na aitava wethiwa no ethike kiwuni
mbika nthini vyu.
Ai mui muno!
Na avika kuu oona liu museo wa
matu ala mai na muyo mwingi ala
mai ma liu wa wiyoo. Anansi ambiia
kwita mata.

stories.title: 0005_anansi-na-nguu.md
stories.text:
Na Anansi atanamba uvikiaa liu uu
waseuvitwe ni Nguu, Nguu
amuungamya.
“Anansi, nduya liu wikite ikoti,
tuyikaa uu kuu kwakwa”.
Anansi kwa kulea kuvindiya asya
“ Ii niw’o mwa Nguu, nivindisyaa
kyau” Na aumya ikoti yake.

stories.title: 0005_anansi-na-nguu.md
stories.text:
Na atena mavia mivukoni kwake ala
matumaa atalela kiwuni, Anansi
alela akenela kiwuni.
Evau akunikila na oona Nguu
aendee kuya liu uu wonthe na
akwatwa ni kimako muno.

stories.title: 0006_ananzi-na-ui.md
stories.text:
Tene tene vyũ andũ maĩ na
kĩndũ ona kĩmwe. Mayesĩ
kũvanda, kana kũtuma ngũa
kana kũtua mĩio ya kyũma.
Nake ngai wa matu Nyame aĩ
na ũĩ w’onthe ĩũlũ wa nthĩ. Aiaa
ũĩ ũsu nthĩnĩ wa mbisũ ya
ndaka.

stories.title: 0006_ananzi-na-ui.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũmwe Nyame
nĩwasũanĩe kũnenge Ananzi
mbisũ ĩsu yaa ũĩ.
Kĩla ĩvinda Ananzi akunĩkĩla
mbisũ nthĩnĩ nĩwamanyaa kĩndũ
kyeũ. Nĩwew’aa mũyo mũno!

stories.title: 0006_ananzi-na-ui.md
stories.text:
Ĩndĩ Ananzi nũndũ wa ĩtomo
nĩwaviindĩĩsye kwiya mbisũ ĩũlũ
wa mũtĩ vala mũndũ ũtamyona
nĩkana ekale na mbisũ ĩsu ee
weka.
Nĩwatumie ĩkanda ya mũsavivũ
na oovea ĩkanda ĩsu ĩla mbisũ
ya ndaka. Ananzi ĩndĩ niwovee
ĩkanda ĩsu mwĩyovonĩ, mbisũ
wethĩa ĩsũĩte mbee wake, na
anzĩa kũlĩsa mũtĩ.

stories.title: 0006_ananzi-na-ui.md
stories.text:
Ĩndĩ kyaĩ kĩndũ kyũmũ kũlĩsa
mũtĩ akũkũnangwa nĩ mbisũ saa
syonthe. Ananzi nĩwanzĩe
kũthata na kũnoa.
Saa isu syonthe mwana mũnini
wa Ananzi ongamĩte uungu wa
mũtĩ asisĩlĩtye kĩla kyendee.
Nĩwaisye, “kũlĩsa wovee mbisũ
mwongo tikw’o laisi?”
Ananzi nĩwatatie kwovea ĩla
mbisũ mwongonĩ na mũio wake
wethĩwa nĩwavũtha.

stories.title: 0006_ananzi-na-ui.md
stories.text:
Nĩyavalũkile nthĩ na yanyaĩka
tũlungu tunini.
Ũu nĩw’o andũ mamanyie
kũĩma, kũtuma ngũa na
kũsovya mĩio ya kyũma na
syĩndũ ingĩ ila andũ mesĩ kwĩka.

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Lia nai na ukuu wa miaka itano
mwenduuu wakwa niwanengie
muthinzio wai wa kakiti kaina
syumwa itatu.
Muthenya ula mwenduu waetie
katikiti musyi nai na utanu
mwingi muno.
Nineesi nina munyanyawa.

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Ila namwiie nthi, mwenduu
niwavindukie na angulya,
“Umwita isyitwa yiva? Nasisya
kakiti kakwa nanasya “Coco”
mwenduu ni wasengie.
Niwakulilye “Wamwita Coco
niki?. Nasya, “ Nikwithiwa
avwaa ta Cocoa”.

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Ni nakulilye mwenduu kana Coco asyaitwe
eweke. Mwenduu asya kana ve kakiti kangi
kavwaa Coco.
Ninaendie kwona mwanainya wa Coco.

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Ila Coco wonie mwanainya
niwatanie muno.
Nimatinanisye syongo
tameuneena.

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Ninakulilye mwenduu kana nai
ndonya kwia Coco na mwana
inya.
“Niwo” asya. Ateo nomuvaka
umasuvie muno. Kwou kila wioo
ninathaukaa ‘na ngututwaa
twakaukithey mwii.

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Myei mivuthu yathela
mwanainya maneneva,
makwata vinya na uima wa
mwii.
Mai manene wethia nditonya
umasuvia ninyova.

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Ninakulilye mwenduu ose
mwana inya wa Coco.
Ateo ila Coco watiiwe e weka
aina kimako muno.
Neewa tawangulasya, “ Niki
wikie uu?”

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Aeka kuthauka. Mavinda amwe
aleal kutembea nakwa.
Kwi mavinda waisaa liu munini.
Ninamakie. Ninakulilye,
“Ndonya kwika ata kuteethesya
Coco?”

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Na muthenya umwe mwenduu ooka kukethanya .
Ila neewie wasya wake, ninaumalile nzembete.
Mbee ndana mba umwona ninewie ngiti syukuma...

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Itina wa kyuio, Coco na
mwanainya masungia vu mbee
wakwa mena utanu.

stories.title: 0016_munyanya-wa-wakwa-coco.md
stories.text:
Nai na utanu mwingi ndyesi
ngethya uu na kithui mbee
Coco kana mwenduu.
Nineesi Coco nukuseuva nundu
mwanainya niwasyokie.
Tukasembelaa miundani ingi!

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Nĩkalaa ndũanĩ ya Kakuma, vandũ
vavyũ, ve mĩw’a mbiingĩ na mbũĩ
mbiingĩ kwĩ andũ. Ona ndũnyũ
ĩthĩwaa ĩngilu na tũtuka nĩ tũnini.
Andũ maingĩ matũmĩa kĩsululu kũthi
kũndũ kũndũ.

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũmwe mwaitũ nĩwambĩtie
na asya, “Mĩtambo, ũmũnthĩ
nũkũvikya mĩaka thanzatũ. Twĩna
mũthĩnzĩo waku.”
Nĩnakũlilye ,” nĩ mũthĩnzĩo mwaũ?
Nĩ mũthĩnzĩo mwaũ? “Ũnĩ nĩtũkathi
ndũnyũ Endoleti na tũkathi naku,”
mwaitũ nĩwasũngĩie. Mũthenya
wakwa wa mbee wakũthi taũni!
Nena ũtanu mwiingĩ ndyakoma
ũtukũ ũsu.

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũla watĩĩe nĩnongamie
katĩkatĩ wa mwaitũ na mwĩĩtuinya
nĩkĩte sulualĩ wa nginisi wa mbuluu
na tii sati ndune.
Nĩnew’ie nĩ kamũndũ kanini
nũngamĩte katĩkatĩ wa mwaitũ
mũtheke mũasa na mwĩĩtuinya
mũnene mũno na mũnou.

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Mbasi embũsũu kwou nĩnekalĩle
mwaitũ.
Nũndũ wa ũvyũvu mwiingĩ na mũyo
mũvĩtũku nĩnakwatiwe nĩ mĩnoo na
nakoma nzĩanĩ ĩsu yonthe; ndyaona
kĩndũ.

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Twavikie Endoleti sua ĩkuma.
Mwangonĩ kwaĩna kĩveti kyatesaa
masungwa. Ngalĩ ĩmwe kwaĩ aũme
elĩ malanasya makwasĩ moo nthĩ.
Ngalĩ ĩngĩ kwaĩ kĩveti kĩkuvĩ
kyakwete ndeke yakengaa.
“Mwaitũ, mwaitũ, ona ndeke ĩla!

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Katĩ wa ndũnyũ kwaĩna kĩvanda
kĩnene kyatesaa mĩthemba mbiingĩ
ya matunda angĩ nde naona.
“Matunda aa metawa ata?”
nĩnakũlilye mwaitu. Nĩwolotile
amwe na asya, “ aa nĩ masungwa
na aa nĩ mavela. Nĩnalyũkile na
nasya, “namo aa?”

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Katĩka matunda onthe nendie avoo
kũsinda angĩ. Nendie mũmbĩle na
langi wa mo. Nĩnolanĩlw’aa nũndũ
matonya kwĩthĩwa mesama.
Nĩnalyũkĩĩle mwaitũ na namũkũlya,
“nũtonya kũnzoea avoo ĩmwe?”

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Amina kũnzoea avoo nĩnalekilye
kwoko kwake na nakwata ĩtunda na
moko monthe na nayũma.
Ndyaĩĩ naya ĩtunda na mũyo wana
ou ĩngĩ.
Kĩndũ kĩla naĩna vata nakyo saa isu
nĩ avoo yakwa.

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Namina kũya avoo yakwa nĩnendie
kũnene na mwaitũ ĩndĩ ndyamwona.
Nĩnasisisye ngalĩ ĩla twaumĩte ĩndĩ
ndyaona mwaitũ na mwĩĩtuinya.
Nĩnasisisye ngalĩ ya kwoko kwa
aũme, na nasisya ngalĩ ya kwoko
kwa aka ĩndĩ ndyamona.
“Nĩmwambonea mwaitũ?”
Nĩnakũlilye iveti ila syaĩ vau vakuvĩ
syĩkũta maluu ĩndĩ syĩangwatĩĩa.
Nĩnanzĩe kũĩa.

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Ĩvinda ĩnini yathela kĩveti kĩmwe
nĩkyangwatie kwoko na kyandwaa
vandũ vaĩ na syana ingĩ.
Mũndũũme mũnene waĩna kĩng’ee
kĩthungu nĩwangũlilye, “wĩtawa ata
kavĩsĩ?”
“Mĩtambo,” nĩnasũngĩie nendee
kwĩtĩkya methoi.

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Nĩnolanĩlwe kana syana nasyo
nitesawa soko. Nĩnekie kũĩa na
nathyũka nĩsisye kana ve mũndũ
ũkũthooa syana vau lumunĩ.
Kavinda kanini mũndũ mũka ũmwe
nĩwokie na osa kana kamwe athi
nako.
“Yu ninyie natĩe kwoswa na ĩndĩ
ndikesa kwĩnũka ĩngĩ,” nĩna sũanĩĩe
na nanzĩa kũĩa ĩngĩ.

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Ĩla new’ie wasya wa ũla mũndũũme
mũnene waĩna kĩng’ee kĩthungu
akwasya, “Mĩtambo eva?”
nĩnaendee kũĩa ĩnene.
“Nyie ndikwenda kũthi naku”
nĩnaisye ngũĩa na nasemba kuma
vala ve mũndũ ũsu.

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Ĩla mwaitũ na mwĩĩtuinya mew’ie
ĩsyĩtwa yakwa nĩmasembie lumunĩ
ĩsu.
“Mĩtambo! Mĩtambo!” wasya nĩsĩ
nĩwetanie nanethĩie kana nĩ mwaitũ.

stories.title: 0019_muthenya-wakwa-wa-mbee-ndunyu.md
stories.text:
Nĩnekumbatĩle mwaitũ
Na mwĩĩtuinya asya, “Mĩtambo
twĩkũmanzaa tũkũnenge mũthĩnzĩo
wa ĩsyawa yaku.”
Nĩwaumisye ndeke ya mbuluu
ĩkũkengakenga mũvukonĩ.
“Ĩĩ nĩyaku” nĩwaisye.

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
Ivinda ya tene vyu, nyunyi
syaina ikomano. Nimendaa
musumbi ota andu na nyamu
sya kithekani. Ni isuni yiva
itonya utwika musumbi?

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
“Ndiu ya makuyu e vinya na
ailyi ta musumbi” Umwe woo
asya, “Aiyee, nde kilauni na
eetana wasya wake umaa nai”,
Ungi asya, “Aya, Nyaa,
nikwithiwa ni muneeni, akivaa
ta munyambu.” Ungi asya
“Aiyee, ndatonya kuuluka na
musumbi wa nyunyi no nginya
auluke.”

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
“Nikwatya naile utwika
musumbi”. Tausi aneena
aamitye nzau syake, “nani
mwanake muno”. “Wi nzasu
muno” Asya ndundu Khova.
“Kwongela ndwi Mwavilika”. “ Ni
metho manene vyu kukila
nyunyi syonthe, naile utwika
musumbi”.
“Aiyee, tiwe ndundu
makayany’a. Ukomaa sua
iyuma.”

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
Na mayaiwana.
Na umwe asya “ula utonya
kuuluka iulu vyu niwe ukutwika
musumbi”. “Ii’ ii, makayanya na
matuila muno matuni.

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
Mbata Musinga yauluka
muthenya aumwe iulu wa syima
Nkwanzi. Ndiu ya makuyu
auluka avita matheo. Ateo ndiu
yi mavandu yauluka matuku
atatu ite kuungama yangie kula
kwisua.

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
Ndiu yatumua inene “Ninye ni
iulu vyu, ni nyie musumbi.”

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
Ateo aseng’ie muno kwiwa
wasya iulu wake “Chrri, Chirri,
Chirri.”
Iulu wa mutwe vai kasuni kanini
vyu, Ncede kala ni Neddicky. Ka
kwatilikite uthwau wa ndiu
nene.
“Ticki, Ticki, Ticki,” asungia. Ni
wa vyu ninye musumbi!

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
Ndiu auluka aendete na iulu “
Ninye ni iulu vyu ninye
musumbi”, aneneena na wasya.

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
Chirri, chirri, chirri, ninyie ni iulu
ninye musumbi”. Ncede
aneena. Kai kaumalila kuma
uungu wa ndiu”.

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
Nyunyi ingi nisyonaa uu wonthe
na sya thata. Nisyeethie itile
uthwau ula keekwatilite ateo
koona undu ithatite na kalika
iimani ya nzoka.

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
“Ndundu no muvaka uketeele
kaumaluke ukakwate” matavya
Ndundu Khova athi ekala vakuvi
na iima.

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
Ateo isua yavyuva na akoma
mituki.
Ncede akunikila na mituki “wii”
aumaluka athi.

stories.title: 0037_musumbi-wa-nyunyi.md
stories.text:
Ndundu eewie nthoni nundu wa
kueka kasuni kau kavite. Nundu
wa uu asyimaa na aikoma
muthenya ndakoneke ni masuni
aangi.

stories.title: 0039_munduume-wa-mbee.md
stories.text:
Tene tene vyuũ ĩla nthĩ aaĩ nzaũ
syĩĩma nene syakunĩkĩlĩtye nthĩ ta
ĩvula, na mĩtĩ ndaasa yavikaa
matunĩ.

stories.title: 0039_munduume-wa-mbee.md
stories.text:
Ĩũlũ wa nthĩ ĩno kwaĩ ndia ya kĩw’ũ
ngilu na nthithu.

stories.title: 0039_munduume-wa-mbee.md
stories.text:
Nthĩnĩ wa ndia ĩsu kwaĩ
nzoka ilĩ. Nzoka ĩmwe
yelinganĩtye ĩlaa
ĩthungu na ĩlũmu, na
nzoka ĩĩngĩ yaĩ nini na
ndaĩna vinya.

stories.title: 0039_munduume-wa-mbee.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũmwe nĩkwethĩiwe na
kĩtundumo kĩnene.
Ũtisi nĩwamulikile ndia ĩsu mbaka
nthĩ. Kĩw’ũ nĩkyatanĩĩsye kwa ĩvinda
ĩnini.
Nzoka nĩsyonie nthĩ ĩũlũ wasyo ĩna
malangi maingĩ na myũmbĩle
mbingĩ na syũmbe syĩ mavw’ĩa.
Ĩla kĩw’ũ kyavinganie ĩngĩ nzoka isu
syĩaũlwa nĩ wanake ũla sionie.

stories.title: 0039_munduume-wa-mbee.md
stories.text:
Nzoka isu nĩsyanenanisye ĩkyasya: “Twĩamba kwĩkala ndianĩ ĩĩ
nduku na nthithu. Tũthi ĩũlũ tũkoone nthĩ ĩsu.
Nzoka ĩla nini nĩyakũlilye, “tũkekala ata ĩũlũ wa nthĩ?
Tũkendaa tũkungĩte na mavu?”

stories.title: 0039_munduume-wa-mbee.md
stories.text:
Munyanyae nĩwasũngĩie asya,
“nyunyi sya yayaya syĩĩtũtheka
nũndũ wa kũthi kavola. Tũĩkakunga
; tũkatembea.”
Nzoka nĩsyelingũlanilye na
syĩtũngĩanĩe vamwe syambĩĩa
kũthambĩĩa syambatĩte ĩũlũ kyenini.

stories.title: 0039_munduume-wa-mbee.md
stories.text:
Syavika ĩũlũ wa kĩw’ũ kĩndũ kya
ũsenyo nĩkyekĩkie. Mĩthya ya mĩthe
yoo nĩyatũkanie mala elĩ yatw’ĩka
mamutha ma maaũ mena syaa.
Uungu wa syongo syoo nivaumĩlile
moko elĩ mena syaa.

stories.title: 0039_munduume-wa-mbee.md
stories.text:
Nzoka isu nĩsyatw’ĩkie mũndũũme na mũndũmũka.
Ĩla masisĩlanilye nĩmendanie.

stories.title: 0039_munduume-wa-mbee.md
stories.text:
Mũndũmũka nĩwaisye, “nĩtũsovya mũsyĩ wĩtũ syĩĩmani . Kĩla
kĩoko tũkonaa sũa ĩkuma na tũkwĩw’a ũvyũvu wayo miongoni
iitu.

stories.title: 0039_munduume-wa-mbee.md
stories.text:
Mũndũũme wa mbee nĩwaisye, “ũKa”. “Nĩngwĩka ũu,”
mũndũmũka nĩwaisye. Na ĩndĩ nĩmatembeie vamwe malika
nthĩ yoo nzau.

stories.title: 0042_mbiwa-yeewaa-nzaa-na-mba.md
stories.text:
Tene muno vai Mbiwa yeew'aa
nzaa. Yaenda kithekani
kumantha liu.

stories.title: 0042_mbiwa-yeewaa-nzaa-na-mba.md
stories.text:
Oona muti munene wina mba
mbiu. Asisya kitungo kya mba
kiniinite uvongeni iulu muno
vyu.

stories.title: 0042_mbiwa-yeewaa-nzaa-na-mba.md
stories.text:
"Iia syi muyo muno
kwakusisya," asuania we
mwene. Asyoka na itina vanini
nikana atulile iulu muno.

stories.title: 0042_mbiwa-yeewaa-nzaa-na-mba.md
stories.text:
I mba syai iulu muno vyu.
Mbiwa yavalukile nthi na
muongo itavikiite i mba.

stories.title: 0042_mbiwa-yeewaa-nzaa-na-mba.md
stories.text:
Mbiwa yookila na yasyokanga
itina wa vala yambiie.
Yeeyumbany'a kutuulila iulu
muno vyu. Yu aivakuvi kuvikila
mba indi avalukile na muongo
wake munangango.

stories.title: 0042_mbiwa-yeewaa-nzaa-na-mba.md
stories.text:
Atata ingi na ingi, indi ndaavikia
i mba. Aendeeie na
kuvalukanga muvaka muongo
wake wathuka vyu.

stories.title: 0042_mbiwa-yeewaa-nzaa-na-mba.md
stories.text:
Muminukilyoni niweeyitukie na
aekana nasyo na athi.

stories.title: 0042_mbiwa-yeewaa-nzaa-na-mba.md
stories.text:
Mbiwa ndaaiw'a muyo ona
vanini. Aungama, asisya i mba
na asuania, "Ona mba isu ti
mbiu." Aendeea na kyalo kyake.
Ai na nzaa mbingi muno vyu
woondu weew'aa mbee.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Tene tene vyũ, eĩtu atatũ nĩmaendie
kuna ngũ.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Nũndũ sua nĩyaĩte mũno nĩmaendie
ũsĩnĩ kũthambĩa.
Nĩmathaũkie na kũtivũa kĩw’ũ na
kũthambĩa.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Kwa mĩtũkĩ nĩmamanyie kana
nĩmaseleetwe kwĩnũka.
Nĩmekalatile masyoka ndũanĩ.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Mevakuvĩ na mũsyĩ Nozimbele
nĩwakwatie ngingo yake na amanya
kana nĩũlilwe nĩ ĩsoa yake!
Nĩwesũvie anyanyae make akĩmea,
“aũme ndũngei.” ĩndĩ anyanyae
make nĩmaleile makyasya nĩkũtukie.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Kwou Nonzimbele nĩwasyokie ũsĩnĩ
eweka.
Nĩwosie ĩsoa yake na asemba
enũke.
Ĩndĩ nĩwoie nũndũ wa kĩvindu.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Nĩwonie kyeni kĩkumĩla kanyũmbanĩ
kũndũ kũasa.
Nĩwekalatile na akũna oti mwangonĩ
wa kanyũmba kau.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Kwa ũsenyo ngitĩ nĩyavingũie
mwango na yamũkũlya, “wenda
kyaũ?”
Nĩwasũngĩie asya, “nĩnũie na
nendaa vandũ va kũkoma.
“Lika nzĩnĩ kana ngũũme,” ngitĩ
nĩyaisye ũu.
Nonzimbele nĩwalikile kanyũmbanĩ.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Ngitĩ nĩyamũie, “mbuĩe.”
“Ndyauĩa ngitĩ ĩngĩ,” Nonzimbele
nĩwasũngĩie.
“Ua kana ngũũme,” Ngitĩ
nĩyamũtavisye.
Kwou Nonzimbele nĩwauĩe ngitĩ lĩu.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Na ĩndĩ ngitĩ nĩyaisye, “mbalanĩlye
kĩtanda.”
“Ndyalanĩlya ngitĩ kĩtanda ĩngĩ,”
Nonzimbele nĩwasũngĩie.
“Alany’a kana ngũũme,” ngitĩ
nĩyamũtavisye.
Kwou Nonzimbele nĩwalanilye
kĩtanda.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Kĩla mũthenya auwaa na kũtuta na
kũthambĩsya ngitĩ.
Mũthenya ũmwe ngitĩ nĩyaisye,
“Nonzimbele ũmũnthĩ nonendaa
kũkethya anyanyae makwa. Tutaa,
ua lĩu na wĩthambya syĩndũ syakwa
ndanasyokethya.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Ngitĩ aumala oou Nonzimbele
nĩwosie nzwĩĩ itatũ kuma mũtweni
wake.
Nĩwaiie ũswĩĩ ũmwe uungu wa
kĩtanda, ũngĩ mwĩlingĩlĩlo wa
mwango na ũngĩ kyũũnĩ.
Na ĩndĩ nĩwasembie ũndũ ũla ũtonya
enũka.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Ĩla ngitĩ yasyokie nĩyamanzie
Nonzimbele.
“Nonzimbele wĩva?” nĩyakũmũkie.
“Nĩvaa uungu wa kĩtanda,” ũswĩĩ wa
mbee nĩwaisye.
“Nĩvaa mwĩlingĩlo wa mwango,”
ũswĩĩ wa kelĩ nĩwaisye.
“Nĩvaa kyũũnĩ,” ũswĩĩ wa katatũ
nĩwaisye.

stories.title: 0066_nonzimbele-na-nzwii-itatu.md
stories.text:
Ngitĩ nĩyamanyie kana Nonzimbele
nũmĩkengie.
Nĩyasembie na yasemba ndũanĩ ya
andũ.
Ĩndĩ nĩyakitisye aamwanainya ma
Nonzimbele mamyetele na mĩtĩ.
Ngitĩ nĩyalyũkile yasemba na kuma
mũthenya ũsu ndĩaoneka ĩngĩ.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Ĩvinda ĩmwe tene, vaĩ kamwana keetawa Ndemane. Kaaĩna mwĩĩituinya weetawa
Ndemanzana. Ĩla inya na ĩthe woo meetiwe, nĩmaendie kwĩkala na mwendw’ethe.
Ĩndi mayaasũvĩwa nesa.
Nĩmavũawa na myũnzyu ndaasa na kunengwe kaũsũlũ kavũthũ ĩvinda ĩmwe tu kwa
muthenya.
Kwondũ wa ũu nimasembie matoloka.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Nĩmethĩiy’e ngunga ya kwĩkala nthĩnĩ. Maĩna vw’ĩa
nũndũ nĩmew’ĩte kana malya andũ nĩmekalaa
tulĩmanĩ.
Kwoou nĩmasovisye mwango mũlũmu wa kũkunĩka
mũomo wa ngunga ĩsu; maatiie tulima twili tunini
twa kulikya nzeve.
Ndemane nĩwakanisye mwĩĩtuinya amwĩa, “nathi
kusyĩma ĩkala nthĩnĩ wa ngunga na ndũkaue nyama.
Malya-andũ mevata na muuke wa nyama ĩiko”.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Kĩla wĩĩo Ndemane nĩwaetae kĩla ũwaie - kavalũkũ
kana kasũni kana nzia.
Evakuvĩ na ngunga nĩwainaa:
“Ndemanzane, Ndemanzane, kaana ka inya.
Mbingũĩe ngunga ĩno.
Nthũngũlũlũ noilĩke
Ĩna tũlima twĩlĩ.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Ndemanzane nĩwew’aa ũtulu wa kwĩkala nthĩnĩ wa
ngunga mũthenya mũima.
Mũthenya ũmwe mwanaainya athi, Ndemanzane
nĩwaumalũkile athi kũtembea.
Nĩwethĩie kalũsĩ ka kũthaũka nako, na mĩtĩ ya kũlĩsa.
Niwew’ie ena ũthasyo na ena utanu.
Nĩwasũnĩie ndeto ii: “kũtonya kwĩthĩwa vate kĩndũ
kĩĩtawa malya-andũ. Mwendwau atonya kwĩthĩwa
aweetaa malya-andũ nĩkana atwĩkĩe vw’ĩa.”

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũla watĩĩe nĩwew’ie ena ũnyiau wa
kwakania mwaki ote.
Ĩndi aakanisye mwaki ngungani nthĩnĩ mwango
ũvingĩtwe nesa – nĩkana ethĩwe wĩvithonĩ.
Nĩwasũanĩie, “nĩnĩsĩ ngailĩla kasama kanini ĩũlũ wa
mwaki vaĩ ũndũ wĩkĩka. Ũtonya kwĩthĩwa ũndũ museo
mũno kũya lĩu mũue."

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Ĩla mwanaainya wokie mũsyĩ nĩwainie otatene,
“Ndemanzane, Ndemanzane kaana ka inya
Mbingũĩe ngunga ĩno.
Nthũngũlũlũ noilĩke
Ĩna tũlima twĩlĩ.”
Nĩwa mũvingũĩe mwango alika nthĩnĩ. Ĩla Ndemane
woonie nyama mbuue nĩwakũlilye, “Wĩkie ũũ ata
ũtena mwaki?”
Ndemanzane nĩwamũsũngĩie kwa mĩtũkĩ, “Nanĩkie
nyana sũanĩ nza wa ngunga.”
Nũndũ Ndemane aĩ mũnou na ndendaa ngalali,
nĩmekalile nthĩ maya lĩu woo vamwe na ũtanu.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũla watĩĩe nĩwavuvie mawki and auwa lĩu
ĩngĩ. Kavinda kanini amina kũua nĩwew’ie wasya
ũkwina nza wa mũomo, “Ndemanzane, Ndemanzane,
kaana ka inya.
Mbingũĩe ngunga ĩno.
Nthũngũlũlũ noilĩke
Ĩna tũlima twĩlĩ.”
Ĩndĩ wasya ndwew’ĩkaa ta wa mwanaainya.
Ndemanzane nĩwaisye, “Aiie. We ndwĩĩ mwanaainya
wakwa; wasya waku tita wake.” Nĩwew’ie ee ũsũvĩonĩ
wa ngunga.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Okavinda kanini kathela, mũndũ
nĩwainie nza wa ngunga, “mbingũĩe
mwĩĩtuia.”
“Ndemanzane, Ndemanzane, kaana
ka inya
Mbingũĩe ngunga ĩno.
Nthũngũlũlũ noilĩke
Ĩna tũlima twĩlĩ.”
Nũndũ wasya wew’ĩkaa ta wa
mwanaainya nĩwavingũie mwango.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Ĩmũndũ ĩnene ĩna masyulĩ maĩngĩ
nĩyosũie mũomonĩ wa ngunga.
Niyakwatie Ndemanzane mbee wa
atanasemba atoloke. Ndemanzane
aĩna kamwanya okanini ka kwosa
mũu kuma mwakini.
Akuĩtwe nĩwendie etĩte mũu nzĩanĩ
vala mesĩla.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũsu Ndemane nĩwatweete mwaatũ wĩna nzũkĩ mwĩta na aikua na mũvuko atũlĩtye
kĩtuoni.
Ĩla wavikie ngunganĩ nĩweethĩie mũomo wĩ ĩteng’ũ na mwĩĩtuinya atevo. Ĩndĩ mũu
nĩwonanisye nzĩa ya kũthĩ kĩthekanĩ.
Nĩwatĩe mũu mũvaka ona mwaki vandũ vaasanga.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Ĩndĩ yaumaala Ndemane nĩwatilile
ũlii ũla woveete mũvuko na
mwĩĩtuinya aumaala.
Ndemane nĩwakwananisye mũvuko
ũsu na ũla wake wĩna nzũkĩ mwĩta
na syana isu nisyeevithie syetela
syone ũndũ ũla ũkwĩkĩka.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Ĩmũndũ ĩsu ĩkweete na kĩw’ũ yokie
na kĩmwana na mwĩĩtu wake.
Nĩyeiye mwĩĩtu, “lika Nyũmba weete
kĩndũ kĩseo nakwetee vau
mũvukoni.”
Mwĩĩtu nĩwavingũie mũvuko asisye
nĩ kyaũ na aũmwa kwoko nĩ nzũkĩ
na eetana, “Nĩkĩkũmana!”
Kĩmwana nĩkyatũmiwe, “Thi
wamũtetheesye!”. Nakyo kyathi
kyekiwe ota mwĩĩtuinya.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Ĩmũndũ ĩu nĩyalikile nyũmba ĩlonzete ĩkwasya, “Mwĩkoone ta nĩ ndia.” Nĩyavingie mũomo na
yavingũa mũvuko yo mweene.
Nzũkĩ isu nĩsyamalũkile syĩnthatu na syantĩa kũmũmanga mũtwe, manyũũ na metho.
Nĩwatwiwe nthongo na atũvatũva kĩla vandũ na woo mwiingĩ

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Nĩwasembie avalũka ĩtũngũnĩ na
mũtwe wakwama ndakanĩ.
Nĩwalyũkile ekala kĩthukĩ kya mũtĩ
kĩtonya kũtwĩka mwaatũ.
Kwa ĩvinda ĩasa kuma mũthenya
ũsu Ndemane and Ndemanzane
nĩmaĩĩe ũkĩ mũseo kuma mwatũnĩ
ũsu.

stories.title: 0084_ndemane-na-ndemanzane.md
stories.text:
Vakuvi na mwaki vaĩna ĩmũndũ ĩnene ĩna masyulĩ maĩngĩ ĩkalĩte
nthĩ na ĩmũvuko ĩnene vakuvĩ nayo. Ndemane nĩwathengeie
ĩmũndũ ĩu akwĩtwĩkĩthya nũkũthua aĩa, “Nau nivatonyeka
wandetheesya na kĩw’ũ? Nĩnomĩa kũũ na nĩngwenda kĩw’ũ.”
Ĩmũndũ ĩu nĩyamũie, “Nĩngũkwetee kĩw’ũ wambatha kana
ndwĩkwata mũvuko wakwa. Nĩyalikilye mũvuko ũsu nyũmba neesa.

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
Tene, tene vyũ kwaĩ sua
mwonza. Myalĩ ya sua
isu yatumasywa nthĩ
ĩvyũva mũno mũvaka
andũ mayaĩ momĩĩsya
ũvyũvu ũsu.

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
Kwou imwana mwonza
sya mbaĩ yeetawa
mũnda nĩmavangie
kũũa sua isu. Nĩmathie
na moaa sua thanzatũ.

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
Sua ya mwonza
nĩyevithie uungu wa
kĩĩma.

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
Sua yathũa nĩkwethĩiwe
na kĩvindu. Nzia
ndyaĩyona ngo, nzou
nayo akinyangaa mĩtĩ
natwo tũvalũkũ
twatembea ĩũlũ wa
mĩnyambũ na kwaĩ na
kĩvũsavũsany’o kĩla
vandũ.

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
Nyamũ nĩsyethĩiwe na
mũkutano nĩkana
ivange ũndũ ikwĩka .
Kavalũkũ nĩkamatavisye
ĩũlũ wa sua ya mwonza
ĩla yevithĩte uungu wa
kĩĩma.
Ĩndĩ nũũ ũla ũtonya
kwĩta sua ĩsu?

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
“Nĩngwĩta sua ĩsu,”
mũnyambũ nĩwaisye,
nũndũ nĩwe waĩ
mũsumbĩ wa kĩtheka.
Mũnyambũ nĩwauumie
asya “Sua, sua,
vatonyeka ndũkasembe
ũtwĩvithĩle. Syoka
ũtũmulĩkĩle.”
Ĩndĩ sua
ndyĩamwĩthukĩĩsya.

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
Nzou nĩwe waatĩe
kũnena. Nĩwokĩlilye
mwendende wake na
avuva soo akyasya,
“Sua, sua, vatonyeka
syoka.”
Ĩndĩ sua
ndyĩamwĩthukĩĩsya.

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
Vikoko na wanake wake
nĩwasũngie na esũvana,
“Sua, sua, vatonyeka
syoka.” Ĩndĩ sua
nĩyaleile kumalũka na
ndĩamethukĩĩsya onthe.
Mũminũkĩlyonĩ Nzamba
nĩyaisye nĩkwĩta sua.
Kĩla mũndũ nĩwathekie.
Ĩndĩ nũndũ mũnyambũ
aĩ mũtongoi mũseo
nĩwaisye, “Nzamba
nĩwaĩlĩte kũnengwa

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
Nzamba nĩ wasongie
mbee na kwa ũuu asya,
“Kookoondokoo-koo.”
Kĩla mũndũ nĩwaseng’ie
nũndũ sua nĩyaumĩlile
vanini uungu wa kĩĩma.

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
Nzamba nĩwaisye ĩngĩ kwa
ũkũmbaũ, ” KookoondoKOO-KOO...”
Sua nĩyaumĩlangile ĩngĩ ĩũlũ vanini.
Nzamba nĩwaisye ĩla ya katatũ na
waasya mũnene na ũkũmbaũ, ”
KOOKOONDOKOO-KOO...” na sua
yambata ĩũlũ na yakenũka.
Nyamũ syonthe sya kĩthekanĩ
nĩsyew’ie mũyo na andũ namo
mew’a mena ũthasyo.

stories.title: 0167_sua-ya-mwonza.md
stories.text:
Nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ
nĩsyeiy’e andũ
mekatate ĩngĩ kũwaa
sua na andũ metĩkĩla.
Kuma mũthenya ũsu
nzamba yasya kĩoko
sua nĩyumaa na
ĩkamulĩka matu.

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
Tene, tene vyu Ngai wa itu Nyame
avithite ngewa syonthe isandukuni
ya muti matuni. Kuu nthi andu
mayai na ngewa sya utavanya na
mai athatu. Makulya Anansi
mbuavui mbui amatethye.

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
Anansi aseuvya ulwalui muasa na
atwaia w'o mwii wake waina usasi
nginya ituni.
"No unenge ngewa mwa" akulya
Ngai wa matuni. Na Nyame atheka
Anansi muno na amwia " oo, ngewa
ii ni sya thooa munene, na
ndutonya kusyivia kavwavuli kaa".

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
"Thooa wasyo ni mwau" Anansi
akulya "Mbetee nyamu itatu mbai
na syi mwoo," Nyame asungia "Ngo
yina maeo mavwaa matumo,
Nzweei itong’aa andu na nzoka
imelasya andu onthe.
Atheka na atheka, onaa ngwa syake
to syai vandu vaseo.

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
Anansi atheaa nthi na aitumia ula
ulwalui na avika avindiisya,
avindiisya na akwata usunguio.
Enza iima iluku na akunika na muti
na kiko na enuka aee liu wa wioo.
Kioko vate ngui, Ngo niwalikite
iimani yiu. Akalang’a kila vandu
ateo nde atonya kumaala.

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
"Eka ngutethye munyanyawa"
Anansi aneena, “komeea tumiti tuu
ngukusye ngumalukye". Anansi
alingiliila ulwalui wake wai na usasi
Ngoni vamwe na tumiti na
amikusya amitwaa ituni
kumy’onanyia kula kwai Ngai wa
matu. Ateo nyamu atheka na
amukulya na amukulya " ila ingi ili
syiva.

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
Kwou Anansi atheea ingi kumantha
kyumbe kya keli. Avindiisya na
avindiisya na akwata usungio. Oosa
kikuu kya kiw’u na athi vale Nzweei
syekalaa mutini. Etikiisya kiw’u
kimwe ndalani syoo. Na atema
ithangu ya yiu na ekunikilya mutwe
na eyitikisya kiwu kingi mwiini wake
wonthe.

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
"Inywi nzweei, umaalukai mwone,
nikukua! mituki, likai kikuuni
kyakwa na mwikauiwe" nzweei
siendete kuwiwa kwoou syalika
kikuuni kya Anansi.

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
Anansi aseuvya ulwalui ukunikite
kkuu wethia Nzweei siumaluka
onasyatata. Aikua aitwaia Ngai wa
matuni ituni. Na Nyame asya “ya
mwisyo yiva”? Ateo ndathekaa
muno.

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
Kwoou Anansi atheea nthi na
avindiisya na avindiisya ateo
ndaamanya undu ukwika.
Niwakulilye muka ula wai na
usungio museo.
Vamwe moona uvonge muasa
muthungu waina tuvonge tunini
twai na vinya. Ila mavikie usini vala
Nzoka yatuaa mambiisya ngananio.
"Uvonge uu ni muasa" "aiyee ti
muasa", "ii ni w'o".

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
O mituki Nzoka yaumaluuka na
yamakulya meneenanisya kyau? "Ni
nenanasya na kiveti kyakwa"
Anansi asya. "Kyasya muti uu ni
muasa kuukila ateo nyie
ndiwitikila." "Kwawo ni muasa
kuvituka muti uu" Nzoka yasya. " Ni
muasa muno, ni Nzoka nene"
nthimei na muti wenyu.

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
Kwou Anansi eeka uu na
amyoveanisya na muti na tuuvonge
nikana ilunngale. Amy’ova vyu,
Anansi amitwaa ituni.

stories.title: 0169_anansi-ainenge-andu-ngewa.md
stories.text:
Nyame ai no muvaka etikile kana
Anansi niwaiva ituvi. Avingua
isanduku ya muti na anenge ngewa
syonthe Anansi. Anansi aete ngewa
syoonthe ena usindi nthi. Atavya
muka na nyamu ingi vamwe na
andu. Nundu ngewa nisyakuewa ti
sya kuia masandukuni ma muti.

stories.title: 0185_undu-kivindu-kyokie-nduani-ya-opio.md
stories.text:
Tene tene vyũ, kũyaĩ kĩvindu ndũanĩ
ya Opio. Andũ makomaa manoa na
methũkũma masalũkĩtye.

stories.title: 0185_undu-kivindu-kyokie-nduani-ya-opio.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũmwe Opio aĩna ũtanu
mwingĩ nũndũ nĩw’o waĩ mũthenya
wake wa mbee kũthi kũsyĩma
eweka. Opio nĩwosie makitĩ na
aumala ndũanĩ. Kavinda kanini
kathela makitĩ nĩmanzĩe
kũsembany’a nzaaĩ.
Opio nĩwamatĩĩe na asemba kĩlungu
kya masaa maingĩ. Anoa
nĩwathũmũaa na ĩndĩ esemba ĩngĩ.
Ndaona makitĩ make.

stories.title: 0185_undu-kivindu-kyokie-nduani-ya-opio.md
stories.text:
Ĩtina wa matukũ maingĩ nĩwavikie
ndũanĩ yaĩna andũ anini mailye
mbee wa nyũmba syoo. Nĩwendie
nyũmbanĩ ĩmwe na eea mwene,
“nĩsembanĩtye na Nzaaĩ ĩvinda ĩasa
mũno na nenda kũthũmũa.”Mwene
nyũmba nĩwaisye, “ĩkala nthĩ
ũthũmũe. Nũkwenda ũkĩ?” Opio
nĩwew’aa waũni mũno kwou
nĩwanyuie ũkĩ na akoma.

stories.title: 0185_undu-kivindu-kyokie-nduani-ya-opio.md
stories.text:
Akũkĩla ndonaa nthĩ. Nĩwavingũie na
kũvĩnga metho make mavinda
maingĩ na anzĩĩa kwona ũla mũndũ
ailye mbee wa nyũmba. Nĩweie
mũndũ ũsu, “ũnengie kĩndũ kĩthũku
mũno; ndĩkwona nesa."

stories.title: 0185_undu-kivindu-kyokie-nduani-ya-opio.md
stories.text:
Mwene nyũmba nĩwamũie, “vaĩ
kĩndũ kĩthũku naku. Oyu nĩ ũtukũ.
Nũndũ ũtoona ũtukũ. Mũthenya
wathi, ũtukũ nĩũkaa. Twĩthĩwaa na
masaa ĩkũmi na elĩ ma ũtukũ.
Tũthũmũa ũtukũ na twĩthũkũma
mũthenya. Wĩkalaa va? Ndũanĩ
yenyu ndĩ ũtukũ ĩĩ?”
Opio nĩwakũlilye makũlyo maingĩ
ĩũlũ wa ũtukũ nũndũ nĩwendie ũtukũ
mũno. Ndaakoma ĩngĩ; manenie na
mwene nyũmba mbaka kwakya.
Opio nĩwendie kwĩkala mũthenya
ũngĩ nĩkana one ũtukũ ũkũka ĩngĩ.

stories.title: 0185_undu-kivindu-kyokie-nduani-ya-opio.md
stories.text:
Nĩwakomie mũthenya na okĩla
ũtukũ ũtanavika. Nĩwakũlilye
mwene nyũmba amũtavye ũndũ
ũtonya kwĩka nĩkana atwae ũtukũ
ndũanĩ yake andũ make matonye
kũwona. Opio nĩweiwe athi okone
sivũ.

stories.title: 0185_undu-kivindu-kyokie-nduani-ya-opio.md
stories.text:
Sivũ nĩweie Opio atembee athi
ndũanĩ yake wioo ũla waatĩe.
Ndaĩlĩte kũsisya ĩtina nĩkana ũtukũ
ndũkasyoke. Opio nĩwekie ũndũ
wataviwe na anzĩĩa kũtembea
aendete ndũanĩ yake. Nĩwendaa
kũsisya ĩtina ĩndĩ ndatata kwĩka ou.
Nĩwendie mbaka anzĩĩa kwona ndũa
na anyanyae make.

stories.title: 0185_undu-kivindu-kyokie-nduani-ya-opio.md
stories.text:
Mona Opio andũ ma ndũa nĩmakĩie.
Nĩmanzĩĩe kũlonza makwasya, “ni
kyaũ watwetee, Opio? Kĩndũ kĩĩ
kĩkwatĩĩe nĩkyũtũaa. Kĩĩ nĩ kĩvindu
kya kyaũ kĩkwatĩe?”
Opio nĩwaisye, “anyanyawa, kĩvindu
kĩĩ nĩ ũtukũ. Mwĩna vw’ĩa; onakwa
naĩna vw’ĩa.”

stories.title: 0185_undu-kivindu-kyokie-nduani-ya-opio.md
stories.text:
“Kyeni kyooka notũthũkũme naw’o
ũtukũ wooka tũkũthũmũa.”

stories.title: 0189_utathi.md
stories.text: Matunda aa ni ma langi wa mbuluu ngwatu.

stories.title: 0189_utathi.md
stories.text:
Ngua yakwa ni ya langi wa nthambalau.

Ni langi niwendete muno!

stories.title: 0215_liu-wa-kwakya.md
stories.text:
Nau endete mukate.
ĩndi nyie nendete
mũkate wa tositi.

stories.title: 0244_mwiitu-ula-waina-nondo-imwe.md
stories.text:
Tene tene vyu vaĩ na
mũndũũme wekalaa na mũka
na kũmwenda mũno.
Mũthenya ũmwe nĩwaendie
kĩthekanĩ. Enzĩanĩ nĩwakomanie
na mwĩĩtu mũasa, mũtheke na
mwanake.
Nĩwamwendie kwa mĩtukĩ.
Mwĩĩtu nake nĩwamwĩtĩkĩlile
omĩtũkĩ ĩndĩ amũtavya kana
enondo ĩmwe tu.

stories.title: 0244_mwiitu-ula-waina-nondo-imwe.md
stories.text:
Nĩwamũie athi mũsyĩ akatile
mũka nondo ĩmwe amwetee
avikye nondo ilĩ nikana matonye
kũtwaana.
Mũndũũme ũsu nĩwasembie
mũsyĩ, osa kavyũ, avalũkya
mũka nthĩ, na omĩtũkĩ amũtila
nondo.

stories.title: 0244_mwiitu-ula-waina-nondo-imwe.md
stories.text:
Nĩwasembie asyoka kĩthekanĩ
vala watiĩte mwendwa wake.
Ĩndĩ ndamwĩthĩa. Nĩwamwĩtie
kwa ĩsyitwa na wasya mũnene,
ĩndĩ nĩkwethĩiwe kĩvindyo
kĩnene.
Na ĩndĩ niwew’ie wasya
ũkyasya, “wĩtana nĩkĩ? Nũndũ
ũtesĩ wĩkĩthekanĩ kya
Mũsambwa wa Limbeeletwela?”

stories.title: 0244_mwiitu-ula-waina-nondo-imwe.md
stories.text:
Ĩla mũndũũme ũsu wew’ie ũu,
nĩwasembie mũsyĩ mĩtũkĩ ta
kĩsasi...
Ĩndĩ nĩwethĩie mũka akw’a.
Nĩwakwatiwe ni kyeva kingĩ na
nũndũ wa ũndũ ũla wekĩte nake
akw’a.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Tene tene vyũ kwaĩ mũndũ ũmwe ngya na mũka wake. Maĩna kana kamwe ka kelĩtu ketawa Nokũngũ.

Nokũngũ aĩ mwanake na mũthingu.

Asyai make nĩmamwendete mũno.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũmwe asyai make nĩmavangie kũmũtwaa kwa naũme wake mũthui wetawa Mũtonyama.

Inya nĩwamũseũvĩsye kĩsikati kĩseo kĩna malaa na ivungo na wanyũa.

Nĩwamũseũvĩsye ĩsoa ya wanyũa na ĩndĩ amũtũma ndũanĩ ya naũme.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Aendete Nokũngũ nĩwethĩie kalũsĩ na akakĩla akinyangĩte mavia.

Mũingo Nokũngũ nĩwakomanie na kelĩtu kanini kekĩte ilai.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Kelĩtu nĩkamũkũlilye, “Wendete kũ?” “Nendete kũkethya mama Mũtonyama,” Nokũngũ nĩwasũngĩie “Onakwa Mũtonyama nĩ mama na nendete kũmũkethya,” kelĩtu nĩkaisye.

Kwou nĩmatembeie vamwe.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text: Mendanga vanini kelĩtu nĩkaisye, “kĩsikati kyaku nĩkĩseo mũno na ĩsoa yaku nĩyanake, vatonyeka nenge nele.” Nokũngũ nĩwaumisye kĩsikati na ĩsoa yake na anenge kala kelĩtu.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Ĩla kelĩtu kau kaumisye ilai syako nakekĩa ngũa sya Nokũngũ, Nokũngũ nĩwonie kelĩtu kena mwĩthe!

Nokũngũ nĩwew’ie w’ĩa nũndũ nĩwamanyie kelĩtu kau nĩyalyũka.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text: Nĩmatembeangie vamwe na Nokũngũ asya, “ndũngĩe kĩsikati kyakwa na ĩsoa yakwa.” Ĩndĩ yalyũka nĩyaisye, “eka nĩkĩange nginya tũvike mũtĩnĩ ũya.” Nĩyaolotile mũtĩ wĩ kĩĩmanĩ.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Ĩla mavikĩĩe mũtĩ ũsu, Nokũngũ nĩwaisye, “ndũngĩe kĩsikati kyakwa na ĩsoa yakwa.”

“Mbekee tu nĩkĩange nginya tũvike kalũsĩnĩ kala katĩe,” yalyũka nĩyaisye. Nokũngũ nĩwetĩkĩlile nũndũ nĩwakĩaa.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Nĩmavikie kala kalũsĩnĩ na Nokũngũ eea yalyũka, “vatonyeka ndũngĩe kĩsikati kyakwa na ĩsoa yakwa.”

“Mbekee tu nĩkĩange nginya tũvike kanyũmbanĩ kaala vala iveti isu syile nthĩ,” yalyũka nĩyaisye.

Kwou nĩmaendie na mbee.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Ĩla mavikie kanyũmbanĩ yalyuka nĩyalutile Nokũngũ ĩtina na yeya iveti ila syaile vau, “syisyai kelĩtu kaa kekĩte ilai. Kambatĩe mũthenya mũima na nenda kasyoke.”

Nokũngũ nĩwakwatiwe ni nzoni na asemba evitha kyũũnĩ.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Yalyũka nĩyendie nyũmbanĩ ya Mũtonyama na yamwĩa “ninyie mwĩvau Nokũngũ. Asyai makwa mambĩie nũke kwĩkala naku.”

Mũtonyama nĩwathokisye mwĩĩtu ũsu na andũ make mekala nesa na ũthingu na ĩla yalyuka. Ĩndĩ Nokũngũ ekalaa kyũũnĩ na kũya lĩu wa ngitĩ.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Kwi mũthenya Nokũngũ endaa mũũndanĩ akwĩvitha mbembanĩ na akw’ina:

“Thĩna atĩ thĩna nyie. Natũmiwe nĩ tata na inya nũke kwĩkala na mama Mũtonyama. Nzĩanĩ nakomanie na yalyũka na yoosa kĩsikati kyakwa na ĩsoa yakwa. Thĩna atĩ thĩna nyie.”

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũmwe mwanainyaa Mũtonyama ũmwe akĩtembea mĩundanĩ nĩwew’ie wathi ũsu mũseo na wa tei.

Ndamanya vala wathi ũsu waumaa ĩndĩ avika mũsyĩ nĩwatavisye Mũtonyama ndeto sya wathi ũsu.

Mũtonyama ew’a ũu nĩwendie mũũndanĩ na.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Nokũngũ nĩwamũtavisye ũndũ kwekĩkie, ũndũ yalyũka yamũvenie ngũa syake nzeo na yatumwa ekĩa ilai.

Mũtonyama nĩwamwosie na athi nake kwake nake na amũvitha nyũmba nzĩnĩ.

Mũtonyama nĩwesĩ ũndũ ũkũkwatya yalyũka.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Mũtonyama nĩwew’ĩte kana mwĩthe wa yalyũka nĩwendete ĩia na ndwamba kũtia ĩia ũtanywĩte ĩmwe.

Kwou nĩwatavisye aũme make masimbe ĩima ĩnene na makwĩyusũsya na ĩia ĩwaatu.

Nĩwetie eĩtu onthe ma ndũa moke masindane kũtwĩla.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Mwĩĩtu ũla wekĩĩte ngũa sya Nokũngũ nĩwakwatiwe nĩ kĩthikii.

Ndendaa kũtwĩla ĩũlũ wa ĩla ĩima nũndũ nĩwesĩ mwĩthe wake ũkew’a waũni wa ĩia.

Kwou nĩwalikile nyũmba na oveanĩsya mwĩthe na mwĩĩ wake alũmya ũndũ vatonyeka.

Na ĩndĩ nĩwendie kũlikana na eĩtu ala angĩ.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Eĩtu nĩmanzie kũtwĩla ĩũlũ wa ĩima ũmwe ĩtina wa ũngĩ.

Ĩla ĩvinda ya yalyũka yavikie nĩyatatie kũtwĩla ĩla ĩima ĩndĩ mwĩthe wayo nĩwathalĩkile waĩkusya, waĩkusya, waĩkusya, mũvaka ĩla ĩianĩ ĩwatu.

stories.title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
stories.text:
Yalyũka yendee na kwilita ĩianĩ ĩsu ĩwatu aũme nĩmosũisye ĩima na kĩthangathĩ na mathika yalyũka.

Na ũsu nĩw’o waĩ mũthya wa yalyũka.

Ĩndĩ Nokũngũ nĩwekalile nesa na naũme kwa kĩlungu kĩasa.

Ngewa yathelela vau.

stories.title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
stories.text:
Ngi and Mũtwe mũnene
maĩ ndũũ. Mũthenya
ũmwe nĩmaendie
kũtembea.

stories.title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
stories.text:
Nĩmavikie ngũkanĩ ya
ũsĩ na manzĩĩa
kũkananĩsy.

stories.title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
stories.text:
“Ndwamba kũkĩla ũsĩ
ũũ!”
“Nonĩkĩle. Niwe
ũtakĩla!”

stories.title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
stories.text:
Ngi nĩwaisye, “we
twĩla!”
“Aiee, we twĩla mbee,”
Mũtwe mũnene
nĩwaisye.
Kwou Ngi nĩwolũkile
akĩla ũsĩ ũsu.

stories.title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
stories.text:
Mũtwe mũnene
nĩwatwĩlie ũsĩnĩ. Ĩndĩ
nũndũ mũtwe wake waĩ
mũnene ndaalela;
nĩwanzĩĩe kw’indanw’a
nĩ kĩw’ũ.

stories.title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
stories.text:
Ngi nĩwathekie,
“he,hee!”
Ĩndĩ athekie mũno
mũvaka kanyw’a wake
waatũka miondo ĩlĩ.

stories.title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
stories.text:
Sũsũ aĩ vakuvĩ mĩaka mĩongo
mwonza. Aĩ mũthangaau. Mũũndanĩ
kwake avandaa mũvya, mwee,
manga na maiũ. Sũsũ akethaa maiũ
kĩla ĩvinda ya mwaka.
Grandma’s garden was wonderful full of sorghum, millet, and cassava.
But best of all were the bananas.
Although Grandma had many
grandchildren, I secretly knew that I
was her favourite. She invited me
often to her house. She also told me
little secrets. But there was one
secret she did not share with me:
where she ripened bananas.

stories.title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
stories.text:
Sũsũ aĩna syana mbingĩ. Ĩndĩ katĩka
onthe, nyie na aamwaiya na
eetwiya kwa kĩmbithĩ nĩtwesĩ sũsũ
nũtwendete kũvĩta ala angĩ.
Nau nĩwe waĩ ĩlumaita ya sũsũ kwou
sũsũ atũkua kwa nzĩa ya mwanya.
Kwa ngelekany’o nĩwokaa mũsyĩ
kwitũ mavinda maingĩ. Ĩla ena nau
na mwaitũ nĩmathekaa mũno. Na
kĩngĩ nowatwĩtaa nyũmba kwake
mavinda maingĩ. Ĩũlũ wa syĩndũ
syonthe sũsũ nĩwatũtavasyaa
syĩmbithĩ syake ĩndĩ ve kĩmbithĩ
kĩmwe ũtatũtavya: vala waindĩa
maiũ make.
Mũthenya ũmwe nĩnonie kĩkavũ kya
malala kiĩtwe suanĩ nza wa nyũmba
ya sũsũ. Ĩla nakũlilye nĩ kyakĩ
nanengiwe ũsũngĩo ũmwe kana nĩ
kĩkavũ kya syama. Sũsũ anzũngĩa
ou nĩwendee kũalyũla kĩtembe kya

stories.title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
stories.text:
Vakuvĩ na kĩkavũ vaĩna mathangũ
ma maiũ wekalaa akwalyũla ĩvinda
kwa ĩvinda. “Mathangũ asu nĩmakĩ
sũsũ?” nĩnamũkũlilye na anzũngĩa
“aa nĩ mathangũ makwa ma kwĩka
syama.” Mũminũkĩlyo, sũsũ
nĩwombĩanĩe maiũ onthe ala maĩ
nyekinĩ.
Kyaĩ kĩndũ kya kwendeesya kwona
sũsũ, ĩiũ ĩnene matũ ma maiũ na
kĩkavũ kya malala kĩnene. Onew’a
nĩnendaa kwĩloela nĩmanye ũndũ
sũsũ ũkũtũmĩa syĩndũ isu syonthe,
sũsũ nĩwandũmie ngeete kĩndũ
kuma vala ve mwaitũ.

stories.title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
stories.text:
Ndililikana kĩndũ kĩu kyaĩ kyaũ.
Nĩnamwĩsũvie ngũmwĩa, “Sũsũ naku
eka nambe kwona wĩsovya....” “Eke
kwĩthĩwa kana keemu, ĩka ũndũ
watavwa.” Sũsũ nĩwasũngĩie.
Nĩnaumie nĩsembete.
Nasyokethya nethĩie sũsũ ailye nza
wa nyũmba. “Sũsũ, kĩkavũ kĩva na
maiũ na...?” ĩndĩ ũsũngĩo ũla
nakwatie nĩkana, “Syĩvandũnĩ
vakwa va syama.” Nĩnendaa
kũmanya vandũ vau va syama ĩndĩ
namũkũlya sũsũ nĩwendee
kwĩtwĩkĩthya kana ndakwĩw’a na
aendea kw’ina wathi. Nĩnakwie
ngoo.

stories.title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
stories.text:
Matukũ elĩ mathela sũsũ aĩna mĩtũkĩ
ya kũthi mũkutano ndũanĩ.
Nĩwandũmie ngamwosee ndata
yake lumunĩ ya kũkoma. Ĩla
navingũie mwango wa lumu ĩsu
nĩnathokiswe nĩ muuke wa maiũ
makwĩw’a.

stories.title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
stories.text:
Lumunĩ ya nzĩnĩ ĩũsũĩte syĩndũ sya
sũsũ nĩvo vaĩna kĩla kĩkavũ kya sũsũ
kya syama kĩvĩthĩtwe nĩ ĩvula ĩkũũ.
Nĩnavwĩkũie ĩvula na muuke wa
maiũ wongelekela. Wasya wa sũsũ
nĩwandelemilye akwasya, “wĩka ata
we? Ngalatĩle ndata yakwa.”
Nĩnamũsembeesye ndata na
angũlya, “nĩ kyaũ ukwetye kwenyea
kũtheka?” Ĩkũlyo yake nĩyatumiswe
ngũmanya kana nonendee
kwenyeea ĩtheka nũndũ wa
kũmanya vala vandũ va syama.

stories.title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũla watĩĩe sũsũ ooka
kũnena na mwaitũ nĩnosie
kamwanya ka kũsemba nyũmbanĩ
kwake ngasisye maiũ ĩngĩ. Vaĩ
kĩtembe kĩmwe kyew'ĩte vyũ.
Nĩnaumisye ĩiũ ĩmwe na navitha
ĩlindanĩ. Natũngĩa kĩla kĩndũ
nĩnasyokie nyũmba na naya ĩiũ
yakwa na mĩtũkĩ. Ndyaya ĩiũ yany’a
mũyo ũu ĩngĩ!

stories.title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũla watĩĩe nĩnetelile sũsũ
athi kuuna mboka nasemba kũsisya
ala maiũ. Vakuvĩ onthe nĩmew’ĩte.
Ndyenamba kũmĩĩsya kũlea kwosa.
Nĩnosie ana na nekalata kuumala
nolwa kũvwĩka kĩkavũ.

stories.title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
stories.text:
Nuumalĩte kavola na mĩthya ya
syaa sya maaũ Nĩnew’ie sũsũ
akũkoa vu nza. Nĩnatatie kũvitha
maiũ asu ĩlindanĩ. Namina kũya
nĩnasyokie na wethĩa sũsũ
ndanamanya mĩvango yakwa.
Mũthenya ũla watĩĩe waĩ wa
ndũnyũ. Sũsũ nĩwokĩlile tene nũndũ
kĩla wa ndũnyũ nĩwatwaa maiũ meu
na manga kũta. Ndyekalata kũthi
kũmũkethya mũthenya ũsu. Ĩndĩ
ndyenamba kũmwĩvitha kĩlungu
kyaasa.

stories.title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
stories.text:
Masaa ma wĩyoo ĩla netiwe nĩ
mwaitũ na nau na sũsũ nĩneesĩ kĩla
ngwĩtĩwa. Ũtukũ ngũkoma nĩneesĩ
kana ndikang’ea kĩndũ kya sũsũ
kana kya asyai makwa kana kya
mũndũ ũngĩ.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Ivinda ya tene kwai mundu wai na kila kindu – muunda munou, wai na ngombe, malondu na
mbui. Na aendee na ukua andeea kwithiwa na kimako, nundu ndai na kindu kimwe. Ndai
muka.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Aungamite ungu wa muti muthenya
umwe aukiwa ni ivindisya iseo.
Kethiwa ndona kiveti ai atonya
usovya kimwe?

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Kwou ambia kuseuvya kiveti
kyanake kumana na uvonge wa
muti.
Ila waminie kuseuvya ivisa, akita
metho mayo na mavinguka.
Aivevea na yethiwa na thayu.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Kwaw’o kyai kiveti kyanake
utakyona vandu vangi.
Atulya ndu mbee wakyo to akikulya
ethiwe mume wakyo.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Akinenga ngua nzeo, wanyua na
mbete ya mutwe kwonanya kyai
kiveti kitwae. Na akyakia nyumba
ya ndaka na nyeki ila yai vakuvi na
kitina kya muti vala kyaumie.
“Nikukulya kindu kimwe kwatei”.
Atavya kiveti kyake.
“Ndukaatate utavya mundu vala
waumie”.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Kwa kavinda kavuthu, aume ma
muika kuma utuini ungi mambiia
kuneena. “Mundu mukuu ta usu
atonya kwithiwa na kiveti kya muika
kyanake uu ata? Mavanga kukyosa
na kukitwaa kyuuni kyoo”.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Mukuu uu niwethiwe na kyeva
muno.
Ndai atonya kwikala thayu atena
kiveti kiu.
Ateo avindisya yingi, “Ethiwa nina
kindu kyake ndyaile ni kumaka”.
Kwou atuma mavui, kukimantha,
kukinia, na kumwetee o kindu kuma
kwakyo.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Ila makyonie, makiniie kwa
kithyomo kya nyunyi.
Kiveti kya muti kiveti kya muti,
Kiseo kitemoneka. Mwimiu
nututumie tumutungie ngua yaku.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Kya manenga ngua yakyo, na mauluka iulu wa iima, mbusi, maendete kula kwi muume
wakyo.
Akwatie ngua yakyo vakuvi na uthyu na eewa muyo vanini.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Wendi wake uyathela mituki.
Niwatumiie mavui ingi makinie.
Kiveti kya muti, kiveti kya muti
kiseo kitemoneka, mwimiu
nututumie tumutungie mbete yaku
ya mutwe.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Akwete mbete ya mutwe
athumuuka nundu wa kiveti kyake
kikuasa kyuuni kya andu angi.
Kwa kavinda, eeta mavui make ingi.
Thyiuuthi kula kii mukaine, kiveti
kya muti kiveti kya muti kiseo
kitemoneka muimiu niatutumie
tumutungie thayu wake!

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Kwou mathi ivinda ya katatu.
Mavuila ituoni syakyo.
Mainite, kila isuni yatonga itho
mituki kyatwika ivisa. Maau na
moko mavaluka na mutwe. Na
kyavaluka muthangani.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Kavola muume avingilitya kitina kya
muti usini.
Akyungamya na mii yakyo kiwuni.
Nundu wa isua na muthanga,
kyamesya matu ingi.

stories.title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
stories.text:
Na ukungi wikwo matu nimaumasya
wasya.
Otondu kiveti kikaa kikwenda
muume.

stories.title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text:
Mbui,Ngiti na Ng'ombe
mai anyanyae
anene.Muthenyia umwe
maendie kyalo na ngali.

stories.title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text:
Mavika kwisho wa
kyaloi,Ndeleva amea
maive tikiti.Ng'ombe
aiva tikiti wake.

stories.title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text:
Ngiti aiva tikiti
umwingaingi,nundu
ndaii na mbesa ila
syailite.

stories.title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text:
Ndeleva akwenda
utungia Ngiti mbesa sya
uluui,Mbui aumela
asembete ataivite
kindu!

stories.title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text:
Ndeleva athata
muno.Atwaa ngali
atanatungia Ngiti
mbesa sya yuulu.

stories.title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text:
Ni kwio kitumi ona
umunze Ngiti usembea
ngali
akunikile nzini aimaza
Ndeleva ula
utamutungia mbesa
syake sya yuulu.

stories.title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text:
Mbui nake asembaa
aitoloka muumo wa
ngali.Ethia aikia
ndakakwatwe nundu wa
ulea iva tikiti wake.

stories.title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
stories.text:
Na Ng'ombe
ndatelemaa ngali
yukite.Ng'ombe osaa
ivinda yake kukilanilia
nzia nundu niwaivie
tikiti wake wonze!

stories.title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
stories.text: Kyai kiwiyoo kivyu kya wathanthatu mwei wa ikumi na ili. Kila umwe ai muthatu. "Bontle na Mpho na Leroto, umalai muthauke" Mme atutavya. "Ndi kumwenda vakuvi nakwa."

stories.title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
stories.text: Twaumaaluka tusembete. "Tuthii usini" Loreto atutavya. "Vau ni vathithangu." "Indi Mme atwia twikativie usini" Bontle atutavya " Tuyitivia" Leroto asungia. "Tuthauke munyini vakuvi na kiwu."

stories.title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
stories.text: Ateo ithau ya 'libeke' ni ivyu ona ethiwa wi ungu wa miti vakuvi na usi. Mbee twaumya syaatu. Indi twai o avyu. Twaumya sati na sikati. Indi twai o avayu.

stories.title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
stories.text: Twekia maau usini mathithe. Na twombangana kiwu. Mituki twamena kiwu.

stories.title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
stories.text: "Inywi nenyu! Tutiviei" Asya Mpho. "Mme ndakamanya" Twativia na twativia nginya twolwa ni ivinda.

stories.title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
stories.text: Sua yambiia kuthua na twambiia kwiwa mbevo ngua situ syaiva?

stories.title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
stories.text: Twamantha ungu wa miti. Twamantha kithekani Twamantha kila vandu.

stories.title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
stories.text: Ateo vai ngombe syai vakuvi na usi sikuya nyeki syai muyo. Bontle asisya iulu! " Sisya ngombe iya! Yumite kyau? "Iya ilaa itune" Lerato asya."

stories.title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
stories.text: "Ti ilaa itune" Mpho atulya wasya. "Ni sati yaku" Twasisya ngombe ingi yutanyuka kindu ki mbuluu. "Isu ni skati yakwa" Bontle atulya wasya.

stories.title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
stories.text: Twenukie na ngua sya nthini tutetema nikwithiwa kwai na uthithu. "Ni ngombe" Twasya, ngombe nisyosyaie ngua situ Mme niwatwikiiie? Mituki itimba situ syavyuva. Na ti undu wa isua.

stories.title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
stories.text:
Vau tene, vai iimu ika.
Muthenya umwe yiitembea vakuvi
na iia niyonie twilitu tutatu tunini.
Yatukulya “nuu kati wenyu
wendetwe ni asyai onthe.

stories.title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
stories.text:
Kelitu kamwe kasya “mwaitu
ambendete muno”
Kangi kasya “Tata ambendete
muno”
Kakatatu kasya, “nendetwe ni asyai
onthe”.

stories.title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
stories.text:
Iimu yeya kelitu kala kendetwe ni
asyai onthe kayaikye ngu mwongo.
Kwoou kelitu katiia iimu.

stories.title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
stories.text:
Maendanga vanini, kelitu kakulya
iimu “ngu syaku syiva” Iimu
yasungia, “vakuvi na mii iyaa”.

stories.title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
stories.text:
Mavika mitini, kelitu kakulya ingi “
ngu syaku syiva?” Iimu yasungia
kana mangie uvika.

stories.title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
stories.text:
Maenda na makomana na mundu
ula wakulilye iimu “ kana kaku
ketewa ata” Iimu yasya “Ketawa
muvuko unenaa”.

stories.title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
stories.text:
Kelitu katheka muno na kaina
Tinye muvuko unenaa
Nitawa Kaamungei
Uui mwaitu numbendete
Uui – tata numbendete
Ui, kikuu kyakwa
Ninywiaa iia.

stories.title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
stories.text:
Ila mundu wewei kelitu undu kaina,
akataanany’a na akatungia asyai
mako.
Ukewa wathelela vau!

stories.title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
stories.text:
Ivinda ya tene, tene vyu, vee
mbuavui weetawa Anansi. Kiveti
kya Anansi kyai muui museo. Ateo
kila ivinda, Anansi niwendaa weuni
kusamasama liu ula andu utuini
mayauaa vamwe na misyi yoo.

stories.title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
stories.text:
Muthenya umwe avitila kwa
Mbaluku. Kavaluku ai munyanyae.
“Ve mboka mbisuni” Anansi aneena
ewite muyo. Anansi “syinamba
kuvya” kavaluku amutavya, “ateo
nisyuvya mituki, eteela tuye
vamwe”.
“Nindonya kwendeew’a ateo nina
syindu ngwika,” Anansi asya na
mituki. Ukethia etelile ethiwa
aneewa wia eke ni kavaluku.

stories.title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
stories.text:
“Ninisi” Anansi aweta. “Ningwaka
ulwalui. “Ningwovea ulwalui umwe
kuuni kwakwa na ungi mbisuni
yake, liu wavya kusya ulwalui umwe
na ninguka nzembete!” Mbaluku
oona uu ni useo na awika.

stories.title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
stories.text:
“Ningwiw’a mboso syunyunga,”
Anansi aneena atembeete. “Mboso
syina muyo, syi mbisuni syuvya.”
Uka tuye mboso situ”, makuli
mamutavya.”syangiie kuvya.”.
“Nindonya kwendeew’a Tata nguli,”
Anansi asya. Na ingi asya ni
ukuseuvya ulwalui na oveye umwe
kuuni na uungi wovewe mbisuni
nene ya mboso.
Tata Nguli niwoonie kana uu wai
useo na awika.

stories.title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
stories.text:
“Niwa makwasi mainyunga” Anansi
aneena ena muyo atembeete. “
Makwasi na uki wa nzuki,
ningwisilya.
“Anansi”, munyanyae kithangaite
amwita. “Mbisu yakwa yusuite
makwasi na uki wa nzuki! Uka
tuisanie”
“Nonendeewe” Anansi na ingi asya
nukuseuvya ulwalui na umwe
wovewe kuuni kwake na muthia
ungi wovew’e mbisuni ya makwasi.
Munyanyae kithangaiti oona uu ni
useo na eeka w’o.

stories.title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
stories.text:
Ivinda ila Anansi wavikie usini aina
ulwalui wovewe mau make nyanya.
“Uu ni undu u useo” Anansi aiya
ena muyo. “Ndyisi ni mbisu yau
ikuvya mbee.
O saa isu Anansi eewa ulwalui
umwe wakitwa. “Oo”, Anansi
atumua, “Usu ni ulwalui ula wovewe
mbisuni ya mboka sya mbaluku”.

stories.title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
stories.text:
Ew’a ulwalui ungi. Na ungi. Anansi
akuswa kundu kutatu ivinda yimwe.
“Auaa” Anansi atumua ila wewie
ulwalui wa kana wakuswa. Osaa isu
eewa ulwalui wa kataano wakuswa.
Na wathanthatu . Na wa muonza.
Anansi akuswa ngali ii na iya, kila
umwe aikusya. Maau make
makuswaa nginya mathekeva na
mathekeva.

stories.title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
stories.text:
Anansi avingilita alika kiwuni. Ila
molwalui oonthe matwaiswe ni
kiwu, asyoka yingi akwiwa woo
ngukani. “ai, ai, ai, ai”, Anansi,
avevuuka, “ Nikwatya uu ndwii
undu useo, ona vanini “ Kuvikia
umunthi mbuavui Anansi ethiwa na
maau nyanya matheke muno. Na
muthenya usu ndaakwata liu ona
umwe.

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Ĩvinda ya tene na tene,
vaĩna musyĩ wekalaa na
ũtanu.

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Mayaũkitanaa ene kwa
ene. Nimatetheesyaa
asyai moo musyĩ na
mĩundani.

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Ĩndĩ mayanengetwe
mwanya wakũthi vakuvĩ
na mwaki.

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Maĩlĩte kũthũkũma wĩa
woo w’onthe ũtukũ.

Nũndũ mĩĩ yoo yaseovetw’e na mũvũa!

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Ĩndĩ mwana ũmwe aĩ na
mea ma kũthi nza
kwĩanĩkĩa kyeni kya sua.

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũmwe
nĩwethĩiw’e na mea asu
ma kũthi nza muno.
Ĩndĩ aamwanainya
nĩmamũkanisye...

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Ũũi! Mwana ũsu
ndaatetheka.
Nĩwanyinyũkie nũndũ
wa ũvyuvu wa sua.

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Syana sya mũvũa
nĩsyakwatiwe ni kyeva
nũndũ wa kwona
mwanaainya
ainyinyuka.

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Ĩndĩ nĩmethĩiw’e na
mũvango. Nĩmosie
mũndo wa mũvũa ula
wanyinyukie maseovya
kasũni.

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Nĩmosie mwanaainya
kasũni mamũlĩsya ĩũlu
wa kĩĩma kĩtũlu.

stories.title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
stories.text:
Na sua ĩkuuma
nĩwolũkile athi kũu
akwina kyeninĩ kya
kĩoko.

stories.title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
stories.text:
Kwa ivinda iasa, Olokwango
aungamite akenyesya itheka
katikati wa uii wa kwene. Kuma
Malong’ola eli ngali syonthe ili,
vaumite mbusi ila syakomanite
miandani kuseuvya usi. Usi wa
Temu wavitilite uini wa Kweni
ukilitye ki. Kiwu kyaw’o kyai
kinengo kwa ng’ombe, matunda na
mbui sya utuini ovamwe na Nzia ila
yekalaa uini usu.

stories.title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
stories.text:
Maundu maendee nesa muvaka ila
Matata watwikie mutui. Aisye nzia
niseuvwe isilite kiimani nikana
alisae kiimani vate thina wa
uvingilita mbika nthi kavola. Kiima
kya Olokwango nikyathatie muno,
nundu wa kwanangwa kwa
king’ewa kyake ateo kyaumisya.

stories.title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
stories.text:
Muthia wa kyumwa, syana sya
Matata na anyangae moo nimalisaa
kiimani kuthauka. Masembaa kila
vandu, maitulanga mbonge sya
miti, makyakany’a miaki na kumitia
yakene.

stories.title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
stories.text:
Kwa ivinda Olokwango anoa. Kavola
aeka kukenyeesya itheka.
Malong’ola maendeea na unyiva na
uthyu wake waendeea na
ukunzana. Mwisio ila mbusi ili
syang’ala. Nguka sya usi wa Temu
syasianisya kwa kimako. Nzia ila
syai uini syathama nundu vayai
nyeki ndaasa, ithaukia na vandu
vavinyu vaukoma. Ng’ombe, mbui
na malondu syamosa vyu. Kila
umwe eew’a kimako kya kiima kya
Olokwongo.

stories.title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
stories.text:
Andu ma Kwere nimamanyie kana ve kindu kikwenda
kwikwa. Nimakwatanie na maumya Matata kivilani.
Vandu vake manyuva Baraka ula mituki waisye kila
mundu navande ilaa manenge Olokwongo ndaia.
Baraka na andu make maseuvya sikuku na maete
mithinzio ya miti ya maana kwa Olokwongo.

stories.title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
stories.text:
Vai mundu watenbeelaa kiimani kiu
na nyeki yamea yingi. Kwa kavola
itheka ya kiima kya Olokwongo
yaingiva na malongola malikanga.
Kuma malongolani asu mbusi
syaumila ingi. Usi wa Temu
wathayuuka. Mbii syatwika sya
kisunzuni nundu wa miti na nyeki.
Nzia syambiia kusembasemba ingi
ku nyekini. Ng’ombe, mbui, na
malondu syathumua munyini wa
miti.

stories.title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
stories.text:
“Ikala thayu mwasa Baraka, ikala
thayu mwasa Baraka” andu ma
Kwere maina. “Ikala thayu mwasa
Olokwongo” Baraka na andu masya.
“Syana syenyu na syana sya syana
syoo na nzukulu syoo nisyunenge
ndaia kila ivinda.

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Kayanga ekalile na asyai make
nginya metwa emĩaka ĩkũmi.

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Kĩveti kĩmwe kya mũkonyo woo
kyetawa Losa nĩkyamwosie kyathi
kwĩkala nake mũsyĩ kwakyo.
Losa aĩngya na mũkũũ ĩndĩ
aĩmũthingu.

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Kayanga mavinda maingĩ nĩwendaa
tũvulĩnĩ twa asyai make kũmatavya
mathĩna make.

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũmwe ĩla Kayanga
wendie kwona tũvulĩ nĩwanengiwe
mũthĩnzĩo mũseo wa kĩkuu kya
mwanya Kyaumĩlile tũvulĩnĩ twa
asyai make.

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Kĩkuu kĩu nĩkyanie wathi mũseo na
wa ũkiakĩsyo. Kayanga nĩwamanyie
kana wasya ũsu nĩwa inyaake.
Wathi ũsu wendaa ta ũũ...

Kayanga, ee, Kayanga!
Mwanawitu nĩtwakwendete!
Ndwĩweka mwendwa!
Osa kĩkuu kĩĩ mwendwa!
Kĩkuae kĩla vandũ mwendwa!
Kakĩkũkiakĩsye mwendwa!

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Kayanga akuaa kĩkuu kĩu kĩla vandu
vonthe wendaa.
Nũndũ wa kĩkuu kĩũ Kayanga
nĩwew’aa eũsũvĩonĩ wa asyai make.

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Mũthenya ũmwe kĩndũ kĩthũku
nĩkyekĩkie. Kĩkuu kyake
nĩkyatũkanie ĩla wendie kũutĩa kĩw’ũ
ũsĩnĩ.
Kayanga nĩwew’ie ngoo yake onayo
nyatũka.

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Kayanga nĩwakwatie ilungu sya
kĩkuu kĩkuu mokonĩ make manini na
aina:

Nau na mwaitũ
Onai kĩkuu nĩkyakw’a
Kĩkuu kĩla mwanengie.
Nĩkaata, nau na mwaitũ?
Ĩthĩwai athingu namwĩmbony’a kyama...
Kana mwĩovamwe nakwa.

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Kayanga nĩwew’ie wasya wainya
ũkĩmwĩa:
Mwanawitũ,
Osany’a ilungu isu syatiwa.
Tava kĩw’ũ nasyo nawĩthamba
maaũ.
Wamina kũthamba vinga metho
maku.
Kayanga nĩwekie ũndũ wataviwe na
kwa mĩtũkĩ ilungu isu nĩsyetungĩanĩe
syasovya kĩkuu kĩima ĩngĩ.

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Kayanga nĩwaendee kũkua kĩkuu kĩu
kĩla vandũ waendaa. Kĩla vandũ
vonthe wesĩlaa andũ nĩmaseng’aa
na kũmũkũlya kĩkuu kĩu
nĩkyamũthemba mwaũ nũndũ
mayaona kĩngĩ ta kĩu ĩngĩ.
Kĩkuu kĩu kyake nĩkyamũnengae kĩla
ũkwenda.

stories.title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
stories.text:
Akwĩkala na kĩkuu kĩu kya mwanya
Kayanga nĩwesĩ kana asyai make
nĩmamũsũvĩaa na vaĩ kĩndũ kĩthũku
kĩtonya kwĩkĩka.

stories.title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
stories.text:
Ii ni manyatta. Nivo
kwitu. Nyumba yakwa
yi nthini wa kisio kya
Turkana.

stories.title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
stories.text:
Ii ni ngamile.
Nthini wa kisio kya
Turkana andu
nimaithasya nyamu syi
kivathukany’o. Ateo
ngamile ni nyamu
yendekete muno.

stories.title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
stories.text:
Aa ni alimu makwa.
Nindete kuthi sukulu.
Sukulu yakwa yitawa
Lolupe.
Ninendete mwalimu
wakwa wa syindu sya
useuvya na moko.

stories.title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
stories.text:
Ii ni meli.
Meli ni nene.
Itumikaa kwa kukua
andu na miio kiwuni.
Ngathi Mwambasa ni
kwona meli.

stories.title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
stories.text:
Kii ni kitanda.
Nau wanzeuvisye.
Nikitumiaa na mwinawa
wa munduume. Wiwaa
nesa ukikomee.

stories.title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
stories.text:
Ii ni nzamba.
Musyi twi nzamba ili.
Na twi nguku mbiingi.
Nilekasya matumbi
maingi.

stories.title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
stories.text:
Ii ni mbia ni nyamu
nzuku ni syisaa liu.
Nisyanangaa ngua.
Nisyetae mowau.

stories.title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
stories.text:
Ii ni ngiti.
Ngiti ni nyamu sya
musyi.
Ngiti yiitu yitawa Daa.
Ikumaa muno.

stories.title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
stories.text:
Uu ni mwavuli.
Asyai makwa me
mwavuli munene.
Wina langi mutune,
mbuluu, ilaa ya muuti
na kisunzuni.
Ila kwina mbua,
tutumiaa mwavuli
twikauiwe.

stories.title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
stories.text:
Ni kilasi kya keli na ninisi syindu mbingi.
Ningwenda kumanya ingi mbingi.
Kila ndesi ngulasya
musyai kana mwalimu.

stories.title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
stories.text:
Maithiawa me kisunzuni
mavinda onthe.
Kana?

stories.title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
stories.text:
Maiu meu mélangi wa
ilaa ya muuti.
Maiu methi me langi wa
kusunzuni.

stories.title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
stories.text:
Ve kindu nthakameni
kila kimitwikithasya
ndune.
